title: Punter.js - Simple JavaScript 2D Game Engine for Beginners
excerpt: A simple, dependency-free 2D game engine designed to help new developers learn JavaScript by building browser games.
content_html:
A simple 2D JavaScript game engine built for learning.

Learn JavaScript by recreating classic games like Pong, Snake and Asteroids. One HTML file. One script. No build step.

Build your first game

Example games

  • AsteroidsVector movement and shooting
  • PlatformGravity and tile collision
  • PongMovement and ball collision
  • BreakoutCollision and level design
  • TetrisGrid stacking and line clearing
  • SnakeGrid movement and growth

Punter.js was created by the Orca Scan team to teach students how to build browser games with JavaScript. We also simplify barcode tracking :)

content_html_zh:
专为学习而构建的简单 2D JavaScript 游戏引擎。

通过重新创建 Pong、Snake 和 Asteroids 等经典游戏来学习 JavaScript。 一个 HTML 文件。 一个脚本。 没有构建步骤。

构建你的第一个游戏

示例游戏

  • 小行星矢量运动和射击
  • 平台重力和瓷砖碰撞
  • Pong运动和球碰撞
  • Breakout碰撞和关卡设计
  • TetrisGrid 堆叠和线条清除
  • SnakeGrid 的运动和增长

Punter.js 由 Orca Scan 团队创建，旨在教学生如何使用 JavaScript 构建浏览器游戏。 我们还简化了条形码跟踪:)
